goal: Stop the ephemeral-database contract check failing on ghcr.io rate limits by pulling the pinned Supabase images from the public.ecr.aws mirror, without weakening or skipping the check
prohibited_actions: No database write, migration edit, or manual production command
Do not skip, weaken, or mark continue-on-error the ephemeral database check
No secrets referenced in the workflow
required_checks: supabase/tests against an ephemeral database passes on the pull request head
assumptions: The Supabase CLI honours SUPABASE_INTERNAL_IMAGE_REGISTRY and publishes identical pinned tags to public.ecr.aws
This contract is published after the implementation commit dc5ea182d1daf97e5252a54d597aae73eeba367f already exists on the branch
stop_conditions: Stop if the check still fails with a registry rate limit after the mirror change
Stop if the fix would require a repository secret in this workflow
